notes: Workspace/UI release. Adds the new dark-green A.C.E. left rail and slide-out workspace, quick new chat, persistent separate chats and chat history, projects with per-chat assignment, an AI Search entry point that routes through the existing multi-source research engine, ChatGPT-style local image/file attachment chips and image previews, and Live-mode cards showing the current chat/project/current work plus a slide-out artifact preview. The supplied reference images informed the navigation and attachment interactions while the existing A.C.E. logo/color language remains intact. Update, Voice, Stop, Chat/Live, artifact Preview/Edit, regeneration and downloads remain on the validated 1.6.0 runtime. Image attachments are stored/displayed locally in this release; model-side visual understanding is not claimed yet.
